case_name: Gonzales v. Planned Parenthood Federation Of America, Inc.
text:
548 U.S. 939 (2006)
GONZALES, ATTORNEY GENERAL

v.

PLANNED PARENTHOOD FEDERATION OF AMERICA, INC., ET AL.
No. 05-1382.

Supreme Court of United States.
September 1, 2006.

Motion of Alan Ernest to allow counsel, or guardian ad litem, to represent children unborn and born alive denied.
